title.zh: 持有超200万枚$SOL（约2.2亿美元）的SkyAI疑似正在亏损抛售$SOL！
title.en: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!

current_state.zh: SkyAI 正在清算 SOL 储备，近5天累计卖出约125万枚 SOL（约1.38亿美元），以回购其95%的已发行股份。
current_state.en: SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, having sold roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.

updates.title_zh: 持有超200万枚$SOL（约2.2亿美元）的SkyAI疑似正在亏损抛售$SOL！
updates.title_en: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!
updates.what_changed_zh:
链上数据显示，持有超过200万枚SOL（约合2.2亿美元）的SkyAI在过去三天内向交易所转入了56.8万枚SOL（约合6387万美元）。其平均买入价约为194美元，若这些代币被卖出，预计将产生约4600万美元的亏损。

这一转账规模让SOL交易者关注到一个大型单一持有者的潜在抛压，不过抛售行为是根据转入交易所的资金流推断的，并未得到该实体的确认。

该观察涵盖三天内合计56.8万枚SOL的转账，对应其披露的约194美元平均买入成本；4600万美元的亏损为基于该成本价的估算，只有在代币实际卖出时才会兑现。
updates.what_changed_en: On-chain data shows SkyAI, a holder of over 2M SOL (~$220M), has moved 568,000 SOL (~$63.87M) to exchanges in three days, apparently realizing a loss of roughly $46M against a ~$194 average entry.

updates.background_zh: 加密货币媒体报道称，SkyAI是Solana生态中持有大量SOL的知名大户。此次转账信息来自Arkham Intelligence——一个对链上实体进行标注和追踪的公开区块链浏览器与分析平台。链上分析师普遍将“转入交易所”视为可能抛售的代理指标，但这本身并不能证明卖出现已发生。
updates.background_en: SkyAI is described in crypto media coverage as a prominent holder in the Solana ecosystem managing significant amounts of SOL. The transfer was surfaced through Arkham Intelligence, a public blockchain explorer and analytics platform that labels and tracks on-chain entities. Exchange inflows are widely used by on-chain analysts as a proxy for possible selling, but they do not by themselves prove that a sale occurred.
updates.market_impact_zh: 相关传导渠道是SOL现货与衍生品交易所的订单簿流动性：若56.8万枚SOL被实际卖出，将构成潜在的近期卖盘供给，同时也可能影响市场对大户持仓动向的短期情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: The relevant channel is order-book liquidity on SOL spot and derivatives venues: a 568,000 SOL inflow represents potential near-term sell-side supply if it is executed, which can also feed into short-term sentiment around large-holder positioning.

updates.title_zh: 🔍  链上侦探 |  SOL财库公司SkyAI正清算其SOL储备，5天累计卖出约125万枚SOL
updates.title_en: 🔍  链上侦探 |  SOL财库公司SkyAI正清算其SOL储备，5天累计卖出约125万枚SOL
updates.what_changed_zh: SkyAI 被监测到正在清算其 SOL 储备，近5天累计卖出约125万枚 SOL（约1.38亿美元），其中包括约半小时前将211,623枚 SOL 转入 Coinbase Prime；公司公告称此次出售是为了回购其已发行股份的95%。
updates.what_changed_en: SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, having sold roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days, including a 211,623 SOL transfer to Coinbase Prime; the company announced the sale is to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.current_state_zh: SkyAI 正在清算 SOL 储备，近5天累计卖出约125万枚 SOL（约1.38亿美元），以回购其95%的已发行股份。
updates.current_state_en: SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, having sold roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nasdaq-listed SOL treasury firm SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, selling roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days — including a 211,623 SOL transfer to Coinbase Prime — to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nasdaq-listed SOL treasury firm SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, selling roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days — including a 211,623 SOL transfer to Coinbase Prime — to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.background_zh: SkyAI, Inc.（纳斯达克代码：SKYA）前身为 Sharps Technology, Inc.，自称在为全球南方构建 Agentic Finance，并在完成 4.11 亿美元 PIPE 融资的同时采用了基于 Solana 的财库策略。据 The Block 报道，目前规模最大的 SOL 财库公司 Forward 自 6 月中旬起寻求收购 SkyAI，在 SkyAI 拒绝其首次报价后，于 9 月 15 日提交了更新后的收购提案。
updates.background_en: SkyAI, Inc. (Nasdaq: SKYA), formerly Sharps Technology, Inc., describes itself as building Agentic Finance for the Global South and adopted a Solana-based treasury strategy alongside a $411 million PIPE financing. The Block has reported that Forward, currently the largest Solana treasury company, has been seeking to acquire SkyAI since mid-June, submitting an updated purchase proposal on Sept. 15 after SkyAI rejected its first offer.
updates.market_impact_zh: 相关转账经由面向机构的交易与托管平台 Coinbase Prime 进行，因此这约 125 万枚 SOL 构成短期内规模较大且集中的 SOL 卖方供给。此次减持也会影响市场对数字资产财库（DAT）模式的情绪，其他上市的 SOL 财库公司可能因此面临对其资产负债表承受能力及股价相对持仓折价的审视。
updates.market_impact_en: The transfers are routed to Coinbase Prime, an institutional trading and custody venue, so the roughly 1.25 million SOL represents a large, concentrated pool of sell-side supply for SOL over a short window. The unwind also feeds sentiment around the digital-asset-treasury model, where other listed SOL treasury holders are exposed to scrutiny over balance-sheet capacity and share-price discounts to holdings.
